notes: Je communique en Français, 7e année. Top level = the 8 modules of the Table des matières (p4, page order: MCCP p5, Modules d'apprentissage 1-2, Modules de lecture 1-2, Modules d'apprentissage 3-5), named by the theme/work title printed under each module label (the reading modules are named by the studied work; the MCCP keeps its full printed label). Children = text and lesson titles from the large-font headings, in page order. Generic activity labels (Oral, Ecrit, Grammaire, IRE, Projet : Défi-lecture) and Tableaux de conjugaison were dropped. Special glyphs in the headings were decoded as '-', ',' and '(1)/(2)'. The two 'Le récit à la troisième personne' lessons (p127 and the 'Ecrit 2' lesson on p146) and the two 'Un récit, ça se construit' lessons are numbered (1)/(2) to tell them apart. Some lesson pages have no title heading in the extract (for example Module 1 p22-27 and Module 2 Ecrit p76), so children may be incomplete. The two reading modules have no recoverable sub-structure. The preface page (p3) is unreadable OCR, but it holds no structure.
